list: The official 55-trophy PlayStation 5 list, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; guides are our own words.
note: 28 of the 55 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned. The spoiler setting in this guide hides story trophy names and descriptions until you earn them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap stages in order, save the 100% completion trophy for last, and the platinum pops with it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: The opening mission happens once, at the very start of a playthrough.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and follow its objectives to the end. The trophy pops when the mission completes. It comes naturally on any playthrough, but it is flagged here because it happens once and there is no way back to it on that save except mission replay, which GTA 6 has not confirmed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: it only comes from finishing Chapter 1, and mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The chapter trophy pops when the last Chapter 1 mission ends and the story moves on. Play the story in order and it is unmissable in practice; it is flagged only because mission replay is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: it only comes from finishing Chapter 2, and mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. Keep playing the story in order; clear side content between chapters if you like, but the chapter itself is what counts.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: it only comes from finishing Chapter 3, and mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes and the story moves into its final stretch.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Story-gated: it only comes from finishing Chapter 4, and mission replay is unconfirmed.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter closes, right before the finale. Before the last missions, finish any partner-moment trophies from stage 2 of the roadmap, while your partner is still with you.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: The finale happens once per playthrough; save before it if the game offers a choice.
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Save before the finale if you want to try each ending the game offers, if it offers a choice at all; the trophy itself only needs one finished finale. It is the gold story trophy, so finish the roadmap's earlier stages first.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: A named story mission; flagged until mission replay is confirmed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. Follow the objectives to the end screen; the trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: A named story mission; flagged until mission replay is confirmed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story heist mission The Cartel Heist. Heists usually need a setup phase first, so finish any setup the game asks for, then run the heist itself to the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: A named story mission; flagged until mission replay is confirmed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the mission flow. Follow the objectives to the end screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: A named story mission; flagged until mission replay is confirmed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners when it appears in the mission flow. Follow the objectives to the end screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: A named story mission; flagged until mission replay is confirmed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It takes place around Vice City International Airport, so expect driving and combat around the airport grounds.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: A named story mission; flagged until mission replay is confirmed.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the mission flow. Follow the objectives to the end screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. That means everything the game counts: all story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and challenges. Use the in-game stats page to find what is left, and treat this as the last trophy before the platinum; stage 6 of the roadmap is built around it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total: jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like, as the game counts them. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so it builds up by itself if you drive fast and take jumps; to grind it, repeat stunt jumps and long highway jumps in a fast car or on a bike.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You only need to sample them: one shooting-range session, one race, one fishing trip, one arcade game, one bowling game and the rest. You do not need to win any of them, just try each type once. Open each activity from the map or by walking up to it in the world.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 42 challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy, time or both, so pick the weapon the challenge names, learn the target pattern, and replay any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold. Use the tracker's counter to tick challenges off as you gold them.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's turns before racing it flat out, cut corners where the gates allow, and win one race per location; winning the same location twice does not count twice.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 20 races.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each race event counts once, so you need 20 distinct events. Try street races, off-road and circuit events around Leonida until the counter hits 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the fishing challenge when Cal offers it, match the bait and timing the challenge asks for, and land the bigger catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game: play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Pick a short game first; you do not need a high score, just a finished game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Side-character missions appear as icons on the map; follow Andy's strand through each mission until the last one completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow his missions on the map until the strand's last mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow his missions on the map until the strand's last mission completes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 8 strands.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger; finish 8 chains in full. Strangers appear across the whole state, not just in Vice City, so explore the map and check stranger icons as you travel.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow his missions on the map until the strand's last mission completes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow his missions on the map until the strand's last mission completes.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are found in the world, often at scenic or quiet places; visit each one and complete the meditation. Tick spots off in this tracker as you go so you can see which ones are left.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until he points you at the animal, then track it down and take the shot. Bring a scoped rifle, approach quietly, and watch the wind and the animal's trail.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets, and three complete sets unlocks the trophy. Keep a checklist of which cards you have so you can see which sets are one card short.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 100 locations.
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game check-in style feature: trigger it at 100 different spots. Fast-travel around the map and use it at each new location you visit, so the count builds up while you explore.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 50 challenges.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's checklist of feats across driving, combat, exploration and more; any 50 count, so pick the easiest ones first and let the rest build up naturally as you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner present and a 4-star wanted level; do it while the story keeps you together.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Start a crime spree with your partner in the car or on foot, wait for four stars, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. It is flagged missable because it needs your partner present, so do it while the story keeps you together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner present and three shops in a row; if the wanted level clears, the chain breaks.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, rob each one quickly, and keep the wanted level alive between robberies: if the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over. Do it while your partner is with you.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 100 vehicles.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Entering or driving a vehicle you have not seen before counts it as discovered. Try every class: cars, bikes, boats and planes, and check vehicle variety at car meets, docks and airfields.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least five enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Crowded shootouts are the place to try it; use cover and pick targets in order.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off stunt at a specific place: Vice City International Airport.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: leave Vice City International Airport by a route the airport did not schedule. Steal a plane from the runway or drive out through a service exit; the trophy pops when you leave the airport grounds by an unofficial route. It is flagged missable because it is a one-off stunt at a specific place.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points at Rhinos, the game's tanks. Get into a Rhino situation: steal or drive a Rhino tank, or survive an encounter with one. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet, so try driving a Rhino first and see what the game counts.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras catching you. Plan the entry, move slowly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 5 vaults.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape cleanly after each one. Vault robberies are the big jobs: plan the getaway before you go in, and count each clean escape toward the five.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Intercept a truck on the road, breach it, grab the cash and break away before the police box you in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive or walk into every named area on the map; the game counts an area once you have been there. Use the map to spot gaps in your coverage and sweep the regions you have not visited yet.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one illegal operation per gang and hit all nine. Gangs hold territory across Leonida, so their operations are spread around the map; keep a note of which gangs you have hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach and take in the view; the trophy pops once the drink and the view come together.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off set piece: the showroom may only be smashable once.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom front. It is a one-off set piece, so do it the moment the chance appears. It is flagged missable because the showroom may only be smashable once.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through on a full game; the trophy is about finishing, not the score.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Reads as a one-off story moment with your partner; the exact trigger is not yet pinned down.
trophies.guide: The description hints at a partnership that draws a crowd. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet, so keep playing duo content with your partner and it should come from a standout moment together. It is flagged missable because it reads as a story moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices may lock once made; PSN tracks the count to 500.
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 500 choices.
trophies.guide: Make choices: PSN tracks the count to 500. Dialogue and story choices build the counter, so keep choosing through the game and the trophy lands as the count grows. It is flagged missable because some choices may lock once made, so do not reload saves to undo a choice you want counted.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Needs a failure followed by a success at the right moment; reloading an old save may skip it.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail something, then succeed on the retry. If a mission or challenge fails, retry it right away instead of reloading an old save; the trophy is about the second attempt landing. It is flagged missable because it needs a failure followed by a success at the right moment.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A one-off strange event; it may not repeat.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Explore odd corners of Leonida; the description reads like an easter-egg encounter, something out of place in the world. It is flagged missable because a one-off strange event may not repeat.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: hit a pedestrian with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and keep moving.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and jobs; hand them to your contacts to wash them, and the total builds toward $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, vehicle mods and food all count; the total is cumulative, so it lands naturally as you gear up, or grind it by buying and selling.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress; buy each one when it appears. Keep the money aside, because garages are not cheap.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.targetNote: PSN tracks the count to 10 vehicles.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register vehicles you own or find, and repeat until 10 are on file.

own.label: Our own advice
own.detail: Worked out from the official description alone; not yet verified in the game. Where a place or step is not pinned down, the guide says so.

roadmap.title: First playthrough: the story
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1 to 4 in order and finish the final mission. The 12 story trophies land as you go: the opening mission, the four chapter trophies, the final mission gold, and the six named story missions. Do not rush past the story; the next stage depends on your partner still being with you.

roadmap.title: Partner moments and one-off events
roadmap.text: While the story keeps you and your partner together, grab the situational trophies: the 4-star escape, the three-shop robbery run, the VCIA departure, the showroom smash, the Ocean Beach cocktail, the melee drive-by, and the choice and second-try moments. These are the ones that can slip past if you wait until after the story.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side characters
roadmap.text: Work the stranger strands across Leonida: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a final mission, Bret has a unique hunt, and 8 full stranger strands earn the silver. Strangers are spread across the whole state, so travel.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.text: Sweep Leonida for the countable things: 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK It locations, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas, 8 garages and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Use the counters in this tracker to see what is left.

roadmap.title: Activities, combat and money
roadmap.text: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win races and drone races, try every activity type, finish 50 challenges, rob vaults, trucks and gang operations, and build the money totals: $250,000 laundered and $100,000 spent.

roadmap.title: Cleanup: 100% and the platinum
roadmap.text: Check the in-game stats page for whatever is left, finish it, and the 100% completion gold pops. The platinum follows at once: 55 trophies, one Leonida Legend.
